newsitem.title: USA: Va. Power North Anna nukes at full power - NRC.
newsitem.headline: Va. Power North Anna nukes at full power - NRC.

text.p: Virginia Power Co's 1,820 megawatt North Anna nuclear power plant returned to full service over the weekend after being shut for repairs last week, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
Both the 911 megawatt (MW) North Anna unit 1 and the 909 MW North Anna unit 2 were operating at 100 percent of capacity as of early Monday morning, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
North Anna 1 tripped off line last Thursday due to an electrical problem.
North Anna 2 was shut last Monday to replace a leaking section of high-pressure turbine balance pipe.
The North Anna plant is located in Mineral, Va.

Virginia Power is a subisidary of Dominion Resources. The company operates and holds an 88.4 percent stake in North Anna complex, while Old Dominion Electric Co-operative holds the remaining 11.6 percent.
